title: Sari store spec
description: A convenience-store layout for the Sari Sandbox. Units are meters and degrees. The floor is centered on the origin: x runs from -floor.width/2 to +floor.width/2, z from -floor.depth/2 to +floor.depth/2. Positions are [x, z] on the floor. Yaw turns clockwise seen from above: yaw 0 faces +z, 90 faces +x, 180 faces -z, 270 faces -x.

checkouts.description: Self-checkout counters (about 1.5 m wide by 0.7 m deep).

categories.description: Up to three labels shown on the sign, usually category names.

cable_length.description: Distance from the ceiling down to the sign.

level.description: What one shelf level holds. A category name fills it with random products from that category. An object can list exact products (names from catalog.json), placed in order along the level and must fit its width; the category is inferred from the first product when omitted.

side.description: Stock for one side of a shelf: a single level value for every level, or an array with one entry per level, bottom level first.

shelf.description: A shelving unit. position is the center of its back panel (spine); the front side faces the yaw direction. Stocked sides per type: wall = front (put the spine against a store wall); island = front and back (double-sided aisle shelf); gondola = front, back, left and right (island with end caps; left/right are as seen by a shopper facing the front); fridge = front, behind glass doors. Every stocked side must be given, and no others.

width.description: Length of the front. Defaults: wall 1.5, island 4, gondola 4, fridge 1.25.

level_spacing.description: Vertical distance between levels. Defaults: 0.41, fridge 0.38.

base_height.description: Height of the bottom level. Defaults: 0.2, fridge 0.15.

randomize_each_reset.description: false: random picks are made once and then kept. true: category levels are re-rolled on every reset (not allowed with explicit products).
